title: Very Light Envelope
body:
Trade-only
This item is no longer available unless by means of trading with another player.

"How is it THAT light?"

Description

This is an item only given to those who purchased and played Typical Developers game "Woodmill INC" before it was taken down off roblox. It can no longer be obtained.

Trivia

  • Woodmill Inc. Pre-Alpha lasted from 7/20/21 until 8/16/21, where only 1000 people bought access.
  • The Edward Statue is a reference to Tree Man from Typical Developer's old game Woodmill Inc, where he sat on top of a pillar in the mountains.
